parameters.content:
## 1 · Request
POST webhook used by the report site (http://localhost:8088) and by the companion **form workflow** (http://localhost:5679/form/research-report).

Body: `{ "ticker": "MSFT", "peers": "AAPL,GOOGL" }`

## 2 · Parallel data pulls (all free, no API keys)
- **yfinance** via the local analytics service: prices, fundamentals, statements, peers
- **SEC EDGAR**: ticker → CIK → recent filings (needs a contact User-Agent, set in `.env`)
- **RSS**: Google News + Yahoo Finance headlines

Every branch continues on error, so one failing source never blocks the report.

## 3 · Analysis (Python)
Ratios, peer comps, RSI/MACD/SMA/Bollinger, drawdown, volatility, headline sentiment (VADER) and a heuristic scorecard. Also writes compact briefs for the LLM so the model only sees computed numbers.

## 4 · LLM drafting (local Ollama)
Three passes with JSON-schema structured output: fundamentals → technicals & news → lead-analyst summary. Model and URL come from `.env` (`LLM_MODEL`, `OLLAMA_BASE_URL`).

If a pass fails, the report falls back to rule-based text for that section.

## 5 · Publish & reply
The analytics service writes `report.json` + `report.pdf` to `site/reports/` and updates the index. The caller gets JSON with the report URL (the form workflow then redirects to it).
